validation_ack.reason: Rights Issue IX added 8,138,620,315 shares in late July 2021, so reported FY2021 basic EPS (Rp39) uses weighted-average shares of 31,543,435,722 (FS2021 Note 41, PDF p. 174) while shares_out is the year-end 36,181,312,782. 1,231,127 juta / 31.54bn = Rp39 - the gap is real.

AR2023 (PDF p. 315) and AR2024 (PDF p. 321) both print a 24.9% payout for the FY2022 dividend, but the stated total Rp542,719,691,730 (Rp15 x 36,181,312,782 shares) is 26.96% of FY2022 profit Rp2,013,412,841,780; the AGMS resolution gives no percentage. The printed ratio is stored unchanged; the total and DPS are consistent with each other.

Permata AR2020/AR2021 print the FY2020 closing price as Rp3,140, but the last 2020 session (30 Dec 2020) traded at Rp3,020: the price source scales pre-rights history by 0.874078, which the 2021 rights terms confirm exactly (400,000:116,089 at Rp1,347 imply a cum close of Rp3,060.000 on 8 Jul 2021) and which turns every session of 2019-2021 into whole rupiah on the IDX tick grid; the AR figure does not. Neither source is edited: fundamentals keep the AR value as printed.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.permatabank.com (Akamai 'Access Denied' 403) and www.idx.co.id (Cloudflare) block this server; no challenge was bypassed. Every Permata document was downloaded as an Internet Archive raw capture of the exact permatabank.com URL in source_url (https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>). Timestamps: AR2024 20260720155401; AR2023 20240809061625; AR2022 20250505034548; AR2021 20240624093628; AR2020 20240522180428; FS2021 20240623112743; FS2020 (reissued) 20240624015954; FS2019 20240624232330; FY2025 Public Expose deck 20261002124939; 1H2025 deck 20260104111747; Jun-2025 published report 20250723134420; FY2023 deck 20251231192615; FY2021 deck 20240713164801. KSEI notices and the KSEI-hosted AGMS 2025/2026 announcements were fetched directly from web.ksei.co.id. The Internet Archive holds NO Permata IR document published after the FY2025 Public Expose deck (10 Mar 2026): AR2025, the audited FY2025 FS and every 2026 interim report/deck are missing (CDX checked for documents/pdf/ and the 2025-2026 upload folders).

FY2025 IS DECK-BASED: total assets, gross loans, deposits and equity for FY2025 come from the FY2025 Public Expose deck (company_release, Rp trillion to one decimal, OJK published-report basis) and all FY2025 ratios from its 'Financial Ratios' page. FY2025 net profit (3,587.535 bn) is the exact figure in the AGMS 2026 resolution; FY2025 shares_out is the AGMS 2026 register count (9 Mar 2026). Replace with AR2025 values when it becomes retrievable. Deck loans/deposits use the published-report definition (Dec-24: 154.9 / 185.5 tn) while fy.2019-fy.2024 use the audited FS (Dec-24: 155,754 / 185,843 bn), so FY2025 growth is slightly understated for loans.

INTERIM = H1 2025 (older than fy.2025): no 2026 interim document is retrievable. News headlines report 9M2026 net profit of about Rp2.6 tn (Bisnis.com, 28 Oct 2026) and H1 2026 net profit of Rp1.71 tn, +4.48% YoY (Bisnis.com, 30 Jul 2026). Not stored (news only, articles not readable from this server). Re-run when the H1/9M 2026 published reports become retrievable. Interim money figures are the H1 2025 OJK published report (individual = entity); loan and deposit totals come from the 1H2025 deck because the published report has no total lines.

ENTITY / BASIS: FY2019 and FY2020 statements are consolidated (Bank + PT Sahabat Finansial Keluarga, a small multifinance subsidiary; NCI Rp10 juta). PT SFK became an associate on 30 Dec 2021 (63.64% sold to Honest Financial Technologies; FS2021 Note 1e) and was no longer an associate by end-2024 (AR2024 PDF p. 184 lists no associate; Permata holds 23.43% of PT Honest Financial Technologies as an 'other investment'); from FY2021 the Bank has no subsidiaries and publishes stand-alone statements (AR2024 PDF p. 184). Money figures are stored with basis 'consolidated' (= the full reporting entity) and equity_attr = total_equity from FY2021. All ratios are the Bank's OJK ratios (AR2020 labels its table 'Entitas Induk Saja'), basis 'bank_only'.

BANGKOK BANK TAKEOVER AND BRANCH INTEGRATION (affects FY2019/FY2020 comparability): Bangkok Bank bought 89.12% from Standard Chartered and Astra (effective 20 May 2020), then a mandatory tender offer raised it to 98.71% (KSEI MTO schedule 26 Aug 2020). Bangkok Bank's Jakarta branch and Surabaya/Medan sub-branches (BBI) were integrated into Permata effective 21 Dec 2020 (EGMS 1 Dec 2020, OJK permit 17 Dec 2020). Because both were under Bangkok Bank's common control from 20 May 2020, PSAK 38 was applied from that date only: FY2019 is NOT restated (FY2019 figures are identical in FS2019 and the FY2020 comparative), the FY2020 balance sheet includes the transferred BBI assets (25,271 bn incl. loans 12,541 bn gross, allowance 3,795 bn, deposits 4,536 bn) and FY2020 profit includes BBI's 367.9 bn profit for 20 May-20 Dec 2020 (FS2020 Note 1d). BBI's USD1,465m working capital became a shareholder payable: USD700m was converted into AT-1 subordinated notes (10.8 tn at Dec-2024) and USD765m was repaid and replaced by a Rp10,821,490 juta advance capital payment (equity at Dec-2020), converted into shares in Rights Issue IX (July 2021). Equity therefore jumps 24.0 -> 35.1 tn in FY2020 with no new shares until July 2021.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: one rights issue (PUT IX, ex-date 9 Jul 2021, 400,000:116,089 at Rp1,347). No split, reverse split, bonus or stock dividend (AR2024 PDF p. 20: no share-changing corporate action in 2024; AR2024 share-listing chronology PDF pp. 789-791 ends with PUT IX; KSEI schedules 2019-2026 for cash dividend, rights, merger/split (masr), bonus and stock dividend list nothing else for BNLI). Not share-count events: the 2020 MTO, and Bangkok Bank's 'refloat' of 9.59% (completed 23 Aug 2024; AR2024 PDF p. 72) which cut its stake from 98.71% back to 89.12% (public 10.88%) without new shares. 46,738 class B treasury shares (bought 13 Jan 2021 from shareholders who opted out of the integration, Rp1,338/share; FS2021 PDF p. 170) are unchanged since. Share classes: 26,880,234 class A (nominal Rp12,500) + 36,154,479,286 class B (Rp125) = 36,181,359,520 issued; shares_out is net of treasury.

EPS 2021: reported EPS (Rp39) uses weighted-average shares of 31,543,435,722 because 8.14bn rights shares were issued in late July 2021 (FS2021 Note 41); shares_out is the year-end 36.18bn (validation_ack eps_shares:2021).

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend per year, no interim or special dividends: FY2021 Rp8.5, FY2022 Rp15, FY2023 Rp25, FY2024 Rp30, FY2025 Rp35 (dates from KSEI notices; totals from AR/AGMS documents). FY2020: no dividend (AGMS 27 Apr 2021; payout_ratio stored as 0 from AR2022). FY2019 and earlier not in scope. Each year's statement of changes in equity shows exactly the prior-year final (e.g. FY2024 FS: dividend 904,533 juta).

PAYOUT 2022 IS INCONSISTENT AS PRINTED: AR2023 and AR2024 both print 24.9% for the FY2022 dividend, but Rp542.72 bn / profit Rp2,013.41 bn = 26.96% (24.9% looks carried over from the FY2021 column). Stored as printed with validation_ack payout_total:2022. FY2024 and FY2025 payout percentages come from news (no company document prints them); both agree with amount / profit (30.4%, 35.3%).

RATIO SOURCES AND RESTATEMENTS: FY2020-FY2024 ratios are the AR2024 'Rasio Keuangan' table (latest AR available); FY2025 from the FY2025 deck. FY2023 CAR was restated from 38.7% (AR2023, FY2023 deck) to 35.3% (AR2024, marked 'disajikan kembali'); the Jun-2025 published report explains a similar restatement of Jun-2024 KPMM (wrong risk weights / undrawn commitments). FY2020 ROA/NIM differ slightly between AR2020 (1.0 / 4.7) and later ARs (0.9 / 4.6); later values stored. CoC (net, incl. loss-identification recoveries), LAR and NPL coverage come from analyst/public-expose decks (published-report basis); CoC FY2020-FY2021 not disclosed in any retrieved document.

PRICE 2025: the BNLI share price rose from Rp945 (end-2024) to Rp5,150 (30 Dec 2025) per the FY2025 deck (market cap Rp186.3 tn, P/E 52x); intermediate prints: Rp2,780 at 30 Jun 2025 (1H2025 deck). Expect large daily moves in the price file around mid/late 2025. The AR share tables' printed market caps do not always equal close x issued shares (AR2020, AR2022); only the printed closes are stored.

BRAND: legal name PT Bank Permata Tbk (unchanged). The brand changed on 27 Sep 2024 from 'PermataBank' (diamond icon) to 'Permata Bank' with a lotus icon in Bangkok Bank's 'Active Blue' (AR2024 PDF p. 83). Sharia business unit (UUS) inside the Bank; sharia=false.
